output.reasoning: This posting fails multiple criteria. (1) Role type: 'Applied AI Architects, Partner' is a pre-sales Partner Solutions Architect role focused on GSI/cloud partner relationships, GTM strategy, customer deal support, events, and technical enablement. It is not a hands-on ML/NLP/AI engineering role that builds, trains, and deploys systems, and it does not match her target_roles (Machine Learning Engineer, AI Engineer, Applied NLP Engineer, ML Engineer, Research Engineer). (2) Level: the posting explicitly lists 5+ years of experience in technical customer-facing or partner-facing roles such as Solutions Architect or Sales Engineer. Ananya is a new grad finishing an MS in CS at Boston University (ending 2026-12) with one ML Engineer co-op (2026-01 to 2026-08), so this exceeds the 3+ year cutoff. (3) Location: the role is based in Seoul, South Korea. It is neither US-based nor designated remote, and her willingness to relocate covers only the US. It also asks for fluency in Korean. (4) Skills: there is no formal required-skills section, and the qualifications name few specific technologies (AWS and GCP appear only as partners). So the skills test is not decisive, but the role, level, and location failures are each disqualifying on their own. (5) Sponsorship: Anthropic says it does sponsor visas, so sponsorship would not block her, but the other failures make the posting NOT_RELEVANT.
